_about: W. B. Yeats (1865-1939) as collector and editor of Irish folk tales, not as poet or playwright: Fairy and Folk Tales of the Irish Peasantry (1888), Irish Fairy Tales (1892) and The Celtic Twilight (1893, enlarged 1902). Clean Gutenberg text; US public domain (all before 1929). Added at the coordinator's standing relay (2026-10-02: choose public-domain storytellers batches; Adam may veto). Two books of his own folk-rooted tales were added later: The Secret Rose (1897) and Stories of Red Hanrahan (1904). Widened at the coordinator's standing relay (2026-10-02/03: Lane D chooses its own batches; Adam may veto).

yeats-fairy-and-folk-tales-irish-peasant: Fairy and Folk Tales of the Irish Peasantry, ed. W. B. Yeats (1888)
yeats-irish-fairy-tales: Irish Fairy Tales, ed. W. B. Yeats (1892)

_excluded.yeats-poems-plays: Yeats's poems, plays, essays and autobiographies: outside a storytellers shelf (a poets' lane would hold them)
_excluded.yeats-stories: Rosa Alchemica (PG 5794) and John Sherman and Dhoya (49109): his other fiction; Rosa Alchemica is an occult story, John Sherman a novel. Red Hanrahan and The Secret Rose are held: tales built on Irish folk material
